arxiv-1807-08798.title: Effective Reformulation of Query for Code Search using Crowdsourced Knowledge and Extra-Large Data Analytics
arxiv-1807-08798.creator: Mohammad Masudur Rahman Chanchal K. Roy
arxiv-1807-08798.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Masudur Rahman Chanchal K. Roy. Software developers frequently issue generic natural language queries for code search while using code search engines (e.g., GitHub native search, Krugle). Such queries often do not lead to any relevant results due to vocabulary mismatch problems. In this paper, we propose a novel technique that automatically identifies relevant and specific API classes from Stack Overflow Q & A site for a programming task written as a natural language query, and then reformulates the query for improved code search.

arxiv-2204-05432.title: A Simple Approach to Adversarial Robustness in Few-shot Image Classification
arxiv-2204-05432.creator: Akshayvarun Subramanya, Hamed Pirsiavash
arxiv-2204-05432.description: Abstract Few-shot image classification, where the goal is to generalize to tasks with limited labeled data, has seen great progress over the years. However, the classifiers are vulnerable to adversarial examples, posing a question regarding their generalization capabilities. Recent works have tried to combine meta-learning approaches with adversarial training to improve the robustness of few-shot classifiers.

arxiv-2301-02240.title: Skip-Attention: Improving Vision Transformers by Paying Less Attention Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc
arxiv-2301-02240.creator: Shashanka Venkataramanan, Amir Ghodrati, Yuki M. Asano, Fatih Porikli, Amirhossein Habibian
arxiv-2301-02240.description: Abstract This work aims to improve the efficiency of vision transformers (ViT). While ViTs use computationally expensive self-attention operations in every layer, we identify that these operations are highly correlated across layers – a key redundancy that causes unnecessary computations.

arxiv-2305-12766.title: Explaining Emergent In-Context Learning as Kernel Regression
arxiv-2305-12766.creator: Chi Han, Ziqi Wang, Han Zhao, Heng Ji
arxiv-2305-12766.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have initiated a paradigm shift in transfer learning. In contrast to the classic pretraining-then-finetuning procedure, in order to use LLMs for downstream prediction tasks, one only needs to provide a few demonstrations, known as in-context examples, without adding more or updating existing model parameters.

arxiv-2308-10417.title: The Change You Want to See(Now in 3D)
arxiv-2308-10417.creator: Ragav Sachdeva, Andrew Zisserman
arxiv-2308-10417.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ragav Sachdeva, Andrew Zisserman. The goal of this paper is to detect what has changed, if anything, between two “in the wild” images of the same 3D scene acquired from different camera positions and at different temporal instances. The open-set nature of this problem, occlusions/dis-occlusions due to the shift in viewpoint, and the lack of suitable training datasets, presents substantial challenges in devising a solution.

arxiv-2410-07660.title: Thermodynamic relations for the Cooper pair’s momentum in helical superconductors
arxiv-2410-07660.creator: Koki Shinada, Robert Peters
arxiv-2410-07660.description: Abstract Two thermodynamic relations are proposed for the exact measurement of the center-of-mass (COM) momentum of the Cooper pairs in helical superconductors. The first relation concerns the constraint on the change in the COM momentum in response to the variation in the magnetic field, which is linked to the superconducting Edelstein effect.

arxiv-2502-05356.title: Distillation and Pruning for Scalable Self-Supervised Representation-Based Speech Quality Assessment
arxiv-2502-05356.creator: Benjamin Stahl ∗, Hannes Gamper
arxiv-2502-05356.description: Abstract † † ∗ Work done while an intern at Microsoft Research. † † 1 {}^{\textrm{1}} https://github.com/microsoft/Distill-MOS In this paper, we investigate distillation and pruning methods to reduce model size for non-intrusive speech quality assessment based on self-supervised representations. Our experiments build on XLS-R-SQA, a speech quality assessment model using wav2vec 2.0 XLS-R embeddings.

arxiv-2505-17921.title: Evaluation of Few-Shot Learning Methods for Kidney Stone Type Recognition in Ureteroscopy Thanks: Equal contribution. *Corresponding authors: Thanks: gilberto.ochoa@tec.mx, christian.daul@univ-lorraine.fr
arxiv-2505-17921.creator: Carlos Salazar-Ruiz, Francisco Lopez-Tiro, Ivan Reyes-Amezcua, Clement Larose, Gilberto Ochoa-Ruiz, Christian Daul
arxiv-2505-17921.description: Abstract Determining the type of kidney stones is crucial for prescribing appropriate treatments to prevent recurrence. Currently, various approaches exist to identify the type of kidney stones. However, obtaining results through the reference ex vivo identification procedure can take several weeks, while in vivo visual recognition requires highly trained specialists.

arxiv-2505-20538.title: AstroVisBench : A Code Benchmark for Scientific Computing and Visualization in Astronomy
arxiv-2505-20538.creator: Sebastian Joseph, Syed Murtaza Husain, Stella S. R. Offner, Stéphanie Juneau, Paul Torrey, Adam S. Bolton, Juan P. Farias, Niall Gaffney, Greg Durrett, Junyi Jessy Li

Ultimately, our goal is for these to help scientists derive novel scientific insights.

pmc-10615998.title: Preparation, characterization, and magnetic resonance imaging of Fe nanowires
pmc-10615998.creator: Xiaoming Cao, Shike Hu, Hua Zheng, Aiman Mukhtar, KaiMing Wu, Liyuan Gu
pmc-10615998.description: A facile template method was employed to synthesize Fe nanowires of different sizes, dimensions. Comprehensive analyses were conducted to explore their morphology, structure, composition, and magnetic properties. The surface of as-prepared Fe nanowires was modified with SiO2 by sol–gel method to improve the dispersion of as-prepared Fe nanowires in aqueous solution.

pmc-10689933.title: Dual blockade of CD47 and CD24 signaling using a novel bispecific antibody fusion protein enhances macrophage immunotherapy
pmc-10689933.creator: Yun Yang, He Wu, Yan Yang, Yan Kang, Runjia He, Bei Zhou, Huaizu Guo, Jing Zhang, Jianqin Li, Chunpo Ge, Tianyun Wang
pmc-10689933.description: CD47 and its receptor signal regulatory protein α (SIRPα) act as a dominant antiphagocytic, “don’t eat me” signal. Recent studies reveal CD24 as a novel target for cancer immunotherapy by macrophages in ovarian cancer and breast cancer. However, whether simultaneous blockade of CD47 and CD24 by a bispecific antibody may result in a potential synergy is still unclear.

pmc-10727981.title: Aquatic food loss and waste rate in the United States is half of earlier estimates
pmc-10727981.creator: David C. Love, Frank Asche, Jillian Fry, Ly Nguyen, Jessica Gephart, Taryn M. Garlock, Lekelia D. Jenkins, James L. Anderson, Mark Brown, Silvio Viglia, Elizabeth M. Nussbaumer, Roni Neff

pmc-11358032.description: Key Clinical Message N meningiditis remains an important cause of central nervous system infection. A high index of suspicion is required especially in infants. Notification of such cases contributes to surveillance data and deciding on providing vaccines to the population.

pmc-11431762.title: Effects of High-Intensity Training on Complete Blood Count, Iron Metabolism, Lipid Profile, Liver, and Kidney Function Tests of Professional Water Polo Players

METHODS: This study included twenty professional male water polo players.

pmc-12620879.title: Brief overview of congenital gastric ectopic pylorus: A rare gastric abnormality
pmc-12620879.creator: Chang Wang, Chen-Huan Wang, Wen-Ju Shi, Sheng-Wu Pan, Ya-Qi Zhai
pmc-12620879.description: Congenital gastric ectopic pylorus (CGEP), also known as gastric ectopic pyloric opening, is a rare congenital gastric abnormality. It was first reported and termed by Yu and Zhao from China in 1983, and in 2007, Uraz et al published the first report of CGEP in the English literature.

pmc-12672472.title: Unraveling the multifaceted roles of SPL transcription factors in leaf development
pmc-12672472.creator: Faujiah Nurhasanah Ritonga, Yiran Xu, Bing Cui, Xingfu Liu, Jianwei Gao, Jingjuan Li
pmc-12672472.description: SQUAMOSA Promoter-Binding Protein-Like (SPL) transcription factors are a plant-specific family of regulatory proteins defined by a conserved SBP DNA-binding domain. They play essential roles in plant growth and development, coordinating processes such as the transition from juvenile to adult phase, branching, flowering time, and organ morphogenesis.

pmc-12999320.title: SLC22A3 deficiency leads to cognitive impairment through the cardio-neuroinflammatory axis mediated HA/H1R/NLRP3 pathway in heart failure mice
pmc-12999320.creator: Zhitian Wang, Lv Zhou, Na Zhao, Tianxiao Li, Fan Geng, Jingting Kong, Yahao Zhang, Zhijun Zhang, Qing-Guo Ren
pmc-12999320.description: Heart failure (HF) affects over 64 million individuals worldwide and is strongly associated with cognitive impairment (CI), yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identify solute carrier family 22 member 3 (SLC22A3) might be a candidate gene for HF-induced CI through Mendelian randomization and bioinformatics analysis.

pmc-13238228.title: Comparative evaluation of physical and mechanical properties of ion-releasing and non-ion-releasing bulk-fill restorative composites
pmc-13238228.creator: Majed M Alsarani, Manal Al-Mutairi, Aftab Ahmed Khan
pmc-13238228.description: Objective:This laboratory study aimed to compare the performance of non-ion and ion-releasing restorative composites.Methodology:This in vitro experimental study was conducted at King Saud University from March 2025 to June 2025. The study groups included four bulk-fill restorative composites, consisting of two conventional non-ion-releasing formulations—Filtek Bulk and Tetric EvoCeram Bulk Fill—and two ion-releasing formulations—Beautifil Bulk Restorative and ACTIVA BioACTIVE Bulk.

pmc-13478150.title: Intelligent emotion and behavior recognition for online learners using deep affective computing
pmc-13478150.creator: Priya K, Pradeep G, Ravimaran S
pmc-13478150.description: Teachers in online classes often have limited visibility into how students are feeling and whether they are staying engaged. This paper presents a practical affective-computing framework that analyses webcam video to recognize both facial emotions and learning-centered behavioral states during live virtual sessions.

pmc-13519031.creator: Zhifan Huang, Hanyu Lu, Yu Yang, Yongyi Yuan, Hongfa Ding

pmc-13608681.title: Predictors of Postoperative Morbidity in Hepatic Hemangioma Surgery: A Single-Center Experience
pmc-13608681.creator: Ioana Teodora Ciortan (Popa), Catalin-Bogdan Satala, Robert Daniel Ciortan, Irina Balescu, Emanuela Sevastian, Raul Mihailov, Traian Dumitrascu, Nicolae Bacalbasa, Aurel Nechita, Irinel Popescu
pmc-13608681.description: Background and Objectives: Hepatic hemangioma is the most common benign liver tumor and is usually managed conservatively. When surgical treatment is indicated, accurate preoperative risk assessment is important because surgery is elective and aims to relieve symptoms while minimizing postoperative morbidity. This study aimed to identify preoperative predictors of postoperative morbidity following hepatic hemangioma resection.

pmc-13727335.title: Somatosensory Disturbance and Long‐Term Exposure to Methylmercury: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-13727335.creator: Leonardo Breno do Nascimento de Aviz, Carolina Fonte de Aviz, Fabiana Costa Cardoso, Laura dos Santos Barros, Raphaely Cristiny Sanches Progênio, Mariângela Moreno Domingues, José Maria Farah Costa Júnior, Saul Rassy Carneiro, Carlos Araújo da Costa, Maria da Conceição Nascimento Pinheiro
pmc-13727335.description: Chronic exposure to methylmercury remains a significant public health concern, particularly in populations with high fish consumption. Somatosensory disturbances are among the most frequently reported neurological manifestations, even at exposure levels below internationally established safety thresholds. This review aims to synthesize current evidence on somatosensory disturbances associated with long‐term methylmercury exposure in human populations.
